title: Which Rider Premium Charges are Struck at Suspension
content:
Which of the rider premium charges standing on the premium account of one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders are struck into the arrears figure follows from the rider's standing.

## The rule

**Where the rider stands at active and the rider record carries no day it ended**, only the rider premium charges posted within the days of grace that govern are struck.

**Where the rider record carries a day the rider ended**, only the rider premium charges posted from the day the rider ended are struck.

**Otherwise**, every rider premium charge posted to the rider premium account is struck.

## Condition and charges struck

| The rider record | The charges struck |
|---|---|
| Active, carrying no day it ended | Those posted within the days of grace that govern |
| Carrying a day the rider ended | Those posted from that day |
| Any other standing, carrying no day it ended | Every charge on the account |

## Worked on hypothetical inputs

A rider premium account carries charges of 46.90 USD in each of four successive calendar months up to and including the month of handling, the days of grace that govern giving a span of 3 whole months.

- **Active, with no day it ended:** the three posted within the span are struck, 140.70 USD.
- **Carrying a day the rider ended at the start of the fourth month:** the one posted from that day is struck, 46.90 USD.
- **Suspended already, or in its waiting period, with no day it ended:** all four are struck, 187.60 USD.
